title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease and blood pressure management.

HPI
The patient presents for routine follow-up. He reports generally feeling well with no new complaints. He continues to manage his kidney function, which is currently documented as stage 5. He notes occasional mild swelling in his ankles, which he attributes to standing for long periods. His blood pressure management remains a focus, given his history of hypertension.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Furosemide 20 mg daily

Exam
Vitals: BP 138/84 mmHg, HR 78, Temp 98.6 F. Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally. Cardiovascular exam reveals regular rhythm with no murmurs appreciated. Lower extremities show trace pitting edema bilaterally.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 5. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medications. Monitor blood pressure closely for evidence of worsening hypertension. Encourage daily weight monitoring and adherence to a low-sodium diet. Follow up in three months.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
CKD stage 5 (not documented as ESRD): N18.5.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
